description: An authentic, in-game verified Tier 1 survival starter cottage. Built with 100% collision-safe clearances: flush threshold entry across the porch, double-door clearance, and an authentic community-style 2-wide L-shaped corner staircase with a 2x2 flat landing and reverse-stair undersides climbing toward the high center roof ridge for continuous 5-6 blocks of headroom. Fully equipped with 4 dedicated functional zones: Hearth & Cooking Alcove, Central Living Room, Workshop & Smithing Alcove, and a cozy Loft Bedroom with Study Desk.
features: In-game verified zero-collision player headroom along all walking paths and doorways
Flush foundation: Seamless entry across exterior porch, door threshold, and interior floor
2-Wide L-shaped corner staircase with 2x2 turning landing, reverse-stair finished underside, and under-stair storage
4 Functional Interior Zones: Cooking hearth, living room with chandelier, crafting workshop, and loft bedroom
Full Survival Utility: Working double chest, campfire fireplace, water cauldron sink, smoker, bed, and bookshelf storage
Authentic community aesthetic: 3-layer stone foundation gradient, stripped dark oak timber framing, and contrasting deepslate tile roof trim

title: Medieval Village Blacksmith & Armoury
subtitle: Tier 1 Working Blacksmith with Open-Air Lava Forge, Twin Blast Furnaces & Upper Loft Residence
author: MineVault Studio

screenshots.caption: Exterior Gable Front with Open-Air Lava Forge, Smoking Chimney & Timber Framing
Covered Forge Hearth with Molten Lava Crucible, Blast Furnaces, Anvil & Water Trough
Upper Residential Loft with Bunk Bed, Nightstand Lantern, Bookshelf & Timber Rafters

description: An authentic, in-game verified Tier 1 medieval village blacksmith and weapons armoury rebuilt strictly following master reference techniques. Features an open-air stone and deepslate forge pavilion with a safety iron-gated molten lava crucible, dual active blast furnaces, an anvil, a grindstone, and a steel-quenching water trough. An open timber archway connects directly to an enclosed stone-brick armoury showroom with weapon racks, armor stands, and double storage chests with zero-obstruction lid clearances. An authentic wooden staircase with continuous 3-block vertical headroom ascends toward the central roof ridge, landing onto an open, spacious second-story loft living quarters complete with a blacksmith's bunk bed, study desk, chiseled bookshelf, directional wall-connected glass pane windows, and full gable enclosure.
features: Authentic wooden doors: Right-clickable spruce front door with inverted stair arch lintel (zero awkward iron doors or detached buttons)
Direct open timber archway: 2-wide seamless walking passage connecting the active outdoor forge to the indoor armoury
Physically connected glass panes: Directional East-West and North-South connection flags ensuring panes touch wall jambs and sills seamlessly
Center-ridge ascending staircase: Climbs toward the highest roof pitch with full 3-block headroom and opens into a wide, spacious loft floor (zero dead ends)
Reverse finished stair undersides: Inverted spruce stairs under every step for a clean, professional architectural finish
Full gable and eaves enclosure: Second floor walls and roof triangles fully enclosed with zero open air gaps
Active forge mechanics: Iron-gated lava crucible, twin blast furnaces, water quenching cauldron, working anvil, and continuous smoking chimney flue
